newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones rose 76.58 points to 7,008.20. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index of 100 large-capitalisation stocks closed up 2.04 points to 1,264.90 on Monday.
* Malaysia may release its December 1996 trade data on Tuesday.
* Gaming and hotels firms Genting and Resorts World could release their 1996 earnings reports as early as Tuesday.
* YTL Corp's power unit has been approved for a listing on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
* United Plantations reported a 5.2 percent decline in 1996 net profit.
* Public Finance posted a 21.2 percent gain in 1996 net profit.
* Pernas announced a restructuring to transfer strategic businesses of its units to the group.
